parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token to retrieve the next page of results.

> Do not specify this parameter for your first request. If the response returns a **NextToken**, more results are available. To retrieve the next page, include the returned **NextToken** value in your next request.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the instance is located. Call the [DescribeRegions](~~426062~~) operation to get a list of available regions.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to **INSTANCE**.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The key of the tag.

> Each tag is a key-value pair. This parameter specifies the key.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The value of the tag.

> Each tag is a key-value pair. This parameter specifies the value.
